command.name: security key-manager external barbican show
command.description: This command displays the Barbican Key Management Service configuration for a given Vserver.

parameter.name: config
parameter.description:
If this parameter is specified, the command displays the following information:
verify
verify-host
proxy-type
proxy-host
proxy-port
proxy-username
timeout

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations for the given Vserver.

parameter.name: config-name
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given configuration name.

parameter.name: enabled
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given enabled value.

parameter.name: key-id
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given key id.

parameter.name: application-cred-id
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given application credentials id.

parameter.name: keystone-url
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given Keystone authentication URL.

parameter.name: verify
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given verify value. The verify value can be either true or false.

parameter.name: verify-host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given verify-host value. The verify-host value can be either true or false.

parameter.name: proxy-type
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given proxy-type value. The proxy-type value can be either http or https.

parameter.name: proxy-host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given proxy-host value.

parameter.name: proxy-port
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given proxy-port number.

parameter.name: proxy-username
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given proxy-username value.

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the Barbican configurations with the given timeout value.

example.p: The following example lists all Vservers with Barbican configurations.
example.screen:
cluster-1::*> security key-manager external barbican show
Vserver: vsTest Configuration Name: config1 Key ID: https://sample.com:5000/v3 Application Credentials ID: app_cred_id Keystone URL: https://sample.keystone.com:5000/v3 Enabled? : false
example.p: The following example lists all fields in the configuration for the Vserver vsTest.
example.screen:
cluster-1::*> security key-manager external barbican show -instance
Vserver: vsTest Configuration Name: config1 Barbican Key Id: https://sample.com:5000/v3 Keystone Application Credentials ID: app_cred_id Keystone Authorization URL: https://sample.keystone.com:5000/v3 Verify the Barbican Host?: true Verify the Barbican Host's Hostname?: true Verify the Barbican Host's IP?: true Proxy Type: https Proxy Host: Proxy Port: 0 Proxy Username: Barbican Connection Timeout in Seconds: 10 Is This Barbican Configuration Enabled?: false
